title: Website health
description: SEO and AI visibility summary of the project websites (Pulsar)

kinds.geo_long: GEO · How AI assistants cite you (ChatGPT, Gemini…)

intro: We review your website every week: how Google sees it and whether AI assistants can read and cite it. Tick what you want us to fix and we'll take care of it.
no_audit_client: We're preparing the first report of your website. Check back in a few days.
no_audit_team: Not analysed yet. Press “Analyse now” or wait for the cron (tools/web-audit.php).
request_help: Tick the points you want us to fix: we'll create an issue and tell you how we'll do it.
request_help_team: Creates an issue in the project with the ticked points.
request_body: {user} asks to fix these points of the website report:
requested: Request sent to AFI (issue #{id}). We'll get back to you soon.
request_failed: The request could not be created. Please try again.
no_project: You have no active project to create the request in: please contact AFI.
offer_heading: Want to know how your website is doing?
offer_text: We can check every week how Google finds you and whether ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI assistants can read and cite your website. You'll see a simple summary here with what's worth improving.
offer_body: {user} wants to enable the SEO and AI visibility report of their website (Asteroid → Website health).
team_empty: No project has the report enabled. Open a project, enter its website and tick “SEO/GEO report”.
not_configured: Pulsar is not configured in config.local.php ('pulsar' => ['url' => …, 'token' => …]).
